# PlainRows

> Pay-per-result data APIs (Apify Actors) for SEO metrics, local business leads, reviews, jobs, prices and web data. Each tool returns flat JSON rows; missing values are null; rows with no data are not billed as results.

All tools share one Apify API token. How to call them: https://nadaho.github.io/plainrows/skills/plainrows-data/SKILL.md
